description: File manager for Windows with panes, saved workspaces, indexed search, previews, tags and batch renaming
pre_install: # The stub carries an xz stream of a PPKM file container; 7-Zip reports harmless trailing data from the stub on stderr, so its output is captured and only shown if extraction really fails.
if (-not $payload) { $extract | Out-Host; throw "Could not unpack the Pulse installer payload from $($setup.FullName)." }

foreach ($f in ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($b, 8, $off - 8) | ConvertFrom-Json).files) { $dest = Join-Path $dir ($f.path -replace '/', '\'); New-Item -ItemType Directory (Split-Path $dest) -Force | Out-Null; $fs = [IO.File]::Create($dest); $fs.Write($b, $off, $f.size); $fs.Close(); $off += $f.size }
post_install: # Pulse's launcher refuses any junction in its own path (exit code 50), so retarget the Start Menu shortcut and shim from scoop's 'current' link to the versioned directory.
notes: Enhancement packs (ffmpeg, images, raw, AI, content search) are downloaded and managed by Pulse itself, outside the install directory.
